turns.utterance: Please complete the initial electrode inspection. Check the electrode cap faces for any pitting deeper than one millimeter or mushrooming, examine the cap shank contact surfaces for corrosion or mechanical damage, and inspect the coolant ports on each electrode arm for blockage.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Visual inspection complete. I've checked both electrode caps, the shank surfaces, and the coolant ports. Everything looks good.

ground_truth.node_text: Complete the following checks: 1. Inspect electrode cap faces for pitting deeper than 1 mm or mushrooming. 2. Check the cap shank contact surface for corrosion or mechanical damage. 3. Inspect the coolant port on each electrode arm for blockage.

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Do you observe any electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming, or cracking?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the electrode caps are in good condition. There's some minor surface wear but no deep pitting, mushrooming, or cracks.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode cap damage, severe pitting, mushrooming or cracking?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode face diameter within the wear limit?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, the face diameter is still within the serviceable range. The measurements are above the minimum threshold.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode face diameter within wear limit?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Yes, both electrodes are showing adequate flow. The readings are well above the minimum spec for this electrode size.

ground_truth.node_text: Cooling water flow rate above minimum at both electrodes?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Is the electrode force within plus or minus five percent of the programmed schedule value?

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: No, the load cell is reading low. The measured force is about eight percent below the target setting.

ground_truth.node_text: Electrode force within ±5% of programmed schedule value?

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please adjust the pneumatic pressure regulator on the electrode arm to bring the force back into specification.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pneumatic pressure regulator on electrode arm

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Regulator adjustment complete. I've increased the pressure setting to compensate for the low reading.

ground_truth.node_text: Adjust pneumatic pressure regulator on electrode arm

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Please reverify the electrode force after the regulator adjustment.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify electrode force after regulator adjustment

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: The force is still reading outside tolerance. Even with the regulator maxed out, I'm only getting to about seven percent below target.

ground_truth.node_text: Reverify electrode force after regulator adjustment

turns.speaker: system
turns.utterance: Procedure complete. The electrode force is unrecoverable through regulator adjustment. Please escalate this issue for actuator inspection and notify the maintenance team.

ground_truth.node_text: End, Escalate: electrode force unrecoverable, check actuator
